d:
Rajasthan ke Kuldhara gaon mein ek preservation project ke liye pahuncha architect Avinaash, jahan use milti hai safed dupatte mein ek rahasyamayi aurat. Sunsaan galiyon se guzarte hue woh ek purani haveli tak pahunchta hai, lekin wahan jo raaz saamne aata hai, woh uski zindagi badal deta hai. Deewar par likha uska poora naam aur aaj ki tareekh ek khaufnaak sach ki taraf ishara karte hain.
Aakhir kaun hai Kuldhara ki woh aurat jo kehti hai, “Main gayi hi kab thi”? Aur kya Avinaash is shraapit gaon se bachkar nikal paayega?
Dekhiye Sannata
